fact: The 2021 update of the community health roadmap states that the CSPS's monthly community activity reports are sent to the health district for entry in DHIS2 (Endos-BF), and that decentralised entry by the CSPS themselves is already operational in the Boucle du Mouhoun region; it gives no count of CSPS.
title: Feuille de route pour la santé communautaire : Mise à jour 2021
